name: the captain of the host of the LORD
overview: The captain of the host of the LORD is a male figure who appears as Joshua prepares for the battle at Jericho. His tribe and other personal details are not recorded. This character is significant in the context of divine military leadership during a pivotal moment in Israel's conquest of Canaan.
namesAndTitles: The title 'the captain of the host of the LORD' means 'prince of the army of the LORD,' indicating a divine appointment as a military leader. This title is given by God and emphasizes his role as commander over the heavenly armies.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for this person beyond his explicit role as the army captain of YHVH. His relationship to God is clearly established as a direct commander under divine authority.
scriptureSignificance: This figure is important because he represents God's direct leadership and presence in the battle preparations of Israel. His appearance to Joshua underscores the divine involvement in Israel's military campaigns and serves as a reassurance of God's guidance and power. The captain of the host of the LORD embodies the reality that the LORD himself commands the armies fighting on behalf of His people.
